title: Evaluating the propensity of generative AI for producing harmful disinformation during the 2024 US election cycle
reasoning: The paper focuses on the empirical evaluation of Large Language Models regarding their propensity to generate factual disinformation and the resulting harm (reputational, cognitive, and legal risks). It does not contain a component evaluating or benchmarking religion, faith, or specific moral/ethical philosophical frameworks beyond standard AI safety/harm metrics.
